description:
## Problem
#4329 added full-specification (`run-official`) support for ClickHouse Local (chDB) TPC-H and TPC-DS and CedarDB TPC-DS maintenance, plus the nightly domains `fullspec-chdb` and `fullspec-cedardb` in `.github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml`. #4350 added six SF 1 `official: true` seed-corpus cells (TPC-H 2 streams with RF1/RF2, TPC-DS 4 streams with maintenance) on duckdb, clickhouse-local and cedardb. No SF 1 full-spec run on ClickHouse Local or CedarDB has ever completed: CI covered SF 0.01 only. The seed run on 2026-12-01 07:00 UTC needs all three identities per cohort; one failed combined cell leaves a cohort with two identities and the corpus validator blocks the seed PR.

## Decision gate
After the first scheduled nightly with both full-spec domains:
- Both pass: record QphH/QphDS, stream counts and `transactional` flags in context, then dispatch `seed-corpus.yml` manually for the six SF 1 cells (or wait for the cron) and record the outcome.
- A cell fails on a BenchBox defect: fix it in a PR with a regression test before 2026-11-28.
- A cell fails on an engine limit (memory, unsupported SQL, timeout): owner decides between removing that cell from the seed matrix for this run (as #4309 did) or swapping the engine (Doris, see doris-fourth-full-spec-identity-20261117). No silent skip.

## Guardrails
- Do not relax `--official` requirements, stream counts, or validation to get a pass.
- Do not mark a cell passed from a partial bundle; the bundle must record every required phase.
- Runner memory/timeout changes need owner approval.

## Verification rubric
Pass only if: (1) one nightly run id each for `fullspec-chdb` and `fullspec-cedardb` at SF 1 is cited with green result and the bundle's phases listed; (2) the 2026-12-01 seed run (or a manual dispatch) produced six SF 1 combined bundles that pass the corpus validator, cited by run id and PR; or (3) an owner decision removing or swapping a cell is recorded with its evidence.
